title: Orchestrated regional switchover runbook and restore validation
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Create an end-to-end, operator-friendly runbook and validation harness for orchestrated active->passive regional switchover (failover) and subsequent restore, with automated checks for backups, KV-cache rehydration, and SLO-regression detection.

Scope: 1) Author step-by-step switchover runbook for on-call and SREs including circuit-breaker toggles and load-shedding thresholds; 2) Build a small test harness to validate backup consistency and restore correctness for critical metadata stores (config DB, model manifests, key-value caches); 3) Define and schedule quarterly automated drills with partial traffic canary and full cutover for non-peak windows; 4) Integrate drill telemetry into Console dashboards and create post-drill regression alerts tied to perf SLOs.

Out-of-scope: On-prem air-gapped packaging (handled by Private track) and billing/contract updates during failover.

Risks: Mistimed cache rehydration can cause high 95th p99 latencies or inconsistent responses; rollback procedures must be explicit to avoid duplicate writes during restore.
acceptance_criteria: Operator runbook with clear prechecks, step-by-step switchover, and rollback documented and reviewed
Automated backup verification job that validates snapshot integrity for config DB and model manifests with checksum and row counts
Restore validation harness that performs a full restore to a staging cluster and runs synthetic request suite (functional + performance) against restored state
Scheduled drill calendar in-place with at least one dry-run completed and post-drill report published
Console dashboard updated to include drill timeline and SLO deltas for token latency and error-rate during drills
Playbook tested end-to-end in one scheduled partial switch with < 5% user-facing error increase and documented rollback within SLA window
